title: The Mandrel Group
description:
The Mandrel Group, located in McDonald, Ohio, specializes in the production, repair, and servic
ing of coiling mandrels, rotating hydraulic distributors, gearing, and hydraulic cylinders. Rec
ently, they acquired Fessler Machine Company, enhancing their capabilities in providing special
ized components for the steel industry.
